question: Which shape should the list endpoint return?
notes: Every list endpoint we add from here follows whichever one wins. Both handle pagination; they differ in whether the envelope is always present and whether the cursor is opaque.
how: Read them as the caller, not the author. Which one is harder to use wrong at 2am, and which one survives adding a field next month without breaking anyone?

map.A: envelope + opaque cursor (the shape Stripe uses)
map.B: bare array + Link header (the shape GitHub uses)

blocks.title: caller

blocks.text: Every response is an object, so adding a top-level field later never breaks a caller. The cursor is opaque, so we can change the underlying paging strategy without a version bump.

blocks.title: caller

blocks.text: The happy path is one line: the body is the thing you asked for. Pagination lives in headers, where HTTP already put it, and `curl | jq '.[0]'` works with no unwrapping.
